claims.label: tested
claims.note: Automated probe by the agent on 2026-11-01: GET https://calendly.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server returned HTTP 200 with JSON.

claims.text: The authorize endpoint sent an unauthenticated request to a sign-in page (calendly.com/app/login).
claims.label: tested

So it validates the client and code before issuing anything. It asks for client authentication via the WWW-Authenticate header.
